research_rejections.title: Kite
research_rejections.reason: IMDb identifies a short adult OVA/miniseries about an orphaned contract killer; public plot documentation describes graphic violence and sexual exploitation, but little corroborated supernatural, progression or sustained mystery-system depth. Whole-work evidence is insufficient to confidently characterize the required 42 DNA dimensions, so it is not a candidate.
